notes: The repaste verdict now follows your CPU warning line.
patch_notes: The repaste verdict judged the median peak of your recent full sessions against fixed 95/98°C thresholds, even though the CPU warning line is changeable in Settings — so a lowered line still read "healthy" while the live UI flagged the same peaks as over the line. The verdict now judges the median peak against your current warning line ("hot" at the line, "repaste" 3°C past it), with 95°C kept as the default, and the verdict card shows the line it judged against. New test in round 6 covers the line-following boundaries; all 21 rounds pass.
